d: A lean, athletic build completely enclosed in a futuristic combat suit featuring a light grey and white digital camouflage pattern. The attire consists of a full-face charcoal grey tactical helmet with a vertical glowing red visor, a heavy black tactical vest with red accents and pouches, black reinforced knee pads, and black combat boots. The ensemble is equipped with a black mechanical exoskeleton frame on the right arm and back, while the left hand carries a black equipment case with yellow hazard stripes.
